scope: Revealed area-exit markers, destination labels and six-region map navigation. Checkpoints remain rest locations; no fast-travel rules added.

atlases.copyMethod: byte-for-byte original project atlas reuse; no resample, repaint or generated edit
atlases.licenseClassification: Existing project-authored atlas artwork; not Baldurs Gate 3 or third-party stock pixels.

provenance.assetPolicy: Only existing project atlas PNG bytes enter the runtime; no BG3 image, icon, XAML or UI texture is copied.

cyan.usage: hollow diamond, cardinal ticks, available destination label

lavender.usage: outer rune ring and distance/state text

outline.usage: near-black graphic outline and label backing

uiTokens.glyph: lavender circle with near-black halo, cyan hollow diamond and four cardinal ticks
uiTokens.checkpoint: existing gold rest marker retained; legend text is 休整点
uiTokens.animation: static glyphs and labels; no fast pulse introduced
uiTokens.lockedExit: same rune shape with lower-opacity cyan/lavender and 未开启 wording; reads existing exit.requires flag only
uiTokens.mapMarkerTouchTarget: mobile size=max(84,controlH), controlH>=46 CSS px after current design-resolution conversion

minimap.discovery: Only exits accepted by existing LocalCartography.revealed are drawn.
minimap.insideCircle: rune at actual local metre coordinates relative to player
minimap.outsideCircle: arrow/rune clamped inside chart rim; nearest exit keeps exact bearing; crowded secondary glyphs step slightly along rim while arrows retain true destination bearing
minimap.persistentReadout: nearest revealed destination name and straight-line metre distance; only one name plate prevents label crowding
minimap.inspectApi: hud.miniMap.inspect(): area, revealedExits, nearestExit, readoutVisible, readoutName, readoutDistance, chartRadius

mapPanel.localExits: persistent destination name on dark backing, native rune shape, large marker hit area; selection preserves existing details/mark behavior
mapPanel.regionPicker: expandable header control; switches to two columns when six rows exceed available height
mapPanel.inspectApi: hud.mapPanel.inspect(): mode, region, regionPickerOpen, regionCount, regionAreaCount, selectedPoi, revealedExits, worldPositions

positionCorrection.reason: The first 32 AREAS retain older atlas coordinates while expanded locations use campaign coordinates. Using one campaign composition frame removes mixed old/new underground placement.
positionCorrection.oldU2Behavior: All U2 locations returned the same center coordinate.
positionCorrection.oldU1Behavior: Five original U1 locations used a hardcoded hand layout, while later U1 points fell back to a different coordinate frame.
positionCorrection.currentBehavior: All six regions use their project atlas and distinct campaign composition coordinates, with AREAS.atlas fallback.
positionCorrection.worldRuleImpact: Display coordinates only; no WorldData metre positions, exits, locks, GameSession state or travel methods edited.

validation.sourcePngCopies: All three runtime images match both project assets and preserved source-art copies by SHA-256.
